story.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛：拉塞尔夺冠，勒克莱尔超越诺里斯获亚军
story.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中从杆位发车并全程领先，赢得他2026赛季的第三个周六胜利。法拉利车手夏尔·勒克莱尔和迈凯伦车手兰多·诺里斯分列二三位。

story.originalTitle: F1 Dutch GP: Russell controls sprint race as Leclerc overhauls Norris for second
story.summaryEn: George Russell won the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race from pole, leading all the way for his third Saturday victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and McLaren's Lando Norris finished second and third.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：拉塞尔掌控冲刺赛，勒克莱尔超越诺里斯获第二
乔治·拉塞尔在赞德福特从杆位赢得周六F1冲刺赛，而他的领跑车手积分榜的队友安东内利仅获得第四。
乔治·拉塞尔从杆位统治了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛，赢得他2026年F1赛季的第三个周六胜利。
这位梅赛德斯车手从起步灯灭起一路领先，比赛过程相当平淡，法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔和迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯在干燥的赞德福特赛道上登上领奖台。
此前拉塞尔在周五取得杆位，受益于队友基米·安东内利的底板损坏，后者在SQ1倒数第二个弯道失误，损失了“25个点”的下压力。
这让这位积分榜领跑者在发车格上位列第五，排在拉塞尔和诺里斯组成的前排之后，勒克莱尔和诺里斯的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里分别排在第三和第四。
起步灯灭时，拉塞尔顺利起步，挡住了诺里斯，但安东内利立即在1号弯外侧超越皮亚斯特里，上升了一个位置。
这位19岁车手立即对勒克莱尔施加压力，后者使用软胎起步，而其他车手使用中性胎，但正如预期，超车被证明很困难。
因此在这条狭窄的海滨赛道上，开局几圈相当静止，但实力相当的车手们在保护轮胎的同时仍然彼此紧咬。
然而从第10圈开始，一切开始升温，梅赛德斯允许拉塞尔更用力推进，领先者迅速拉开与此时已显脆弱的诺里斯两秒的差距。
“我的车尾没有抓地力，”这位卫冕世界冠军报告说，他无法将目光从后视镜中的法拉利和梅赛德斯上移开，来自后方的压力从未减弱。
结果勒克莱尔终于在第18圈1号弯内线超越诺里斯，虽然法拉利迅速拉开，但迈凯伦仍必须防守安东内利。
但在赞德福特，跟在前车一秒之内是一回事，超车又是另一回事，诺里斯真正需要做的只是保持在白线之内。
他做到了，这位26岁车手成功守住第三，落后冠军拉塞尔，后者以1.4秒优势领先勒克莱尔冲线，法拉利车手取得他2026年的第三个冲刺赛领奖台。
安东内利获得第四，落后诺里斯0.4秒，落后第五名的皮亚斯特里4.6秒，红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在主场观众面前以0.3秒之差位列第六。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿驾驶另一辆法拉利从未参与竞争，获得第七，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利以第八名拿下最后一个积分位置。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Russell controls sprint race as Leclerc overhauls Norris for second
George Russell won the Saturday F1 sprint race at Zandvoort from pole, while his championship-leading team-mate Antonelli could only muster fourth
George Russell dominated the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race from pole for his third Saturday victory of the 2026 Formula 1 campaign.
The Mercedes driver led all the way from lights out in a rather processional affair, with Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc and McLaren’s Lando Norris completing the podium at a dry Zandvoort.
It came after Russell grabbed pole on Friday after profiting from floor damage for his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who lost “25 points” of downforce due to an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
That left the championship leader fifth on the grid behind a front row of Russell and Norris, with Leclerc and Norris’ team-mate Oscar Piastri respectively lining up third and fourth.
At lights out Russell enjoyed a solid getaway by holding Norris at bay, but Antonelli immediately gained a place with a sweeping move around the outside of Piastri at Turn 1.
The 19-year-old applied instant pressure on Leclerc, who started on soft tyres compared to the rest on medium rubber, but as expected overtaking proved difficult.
So the opening laps were rather static around the tight seaside circuit, but the evenly-matched drivers still remained within touching distance of each other as they preserved their tyres.
Everything started to ramp up though come lap 10 when Mercedes allowed Russell to push harder and the leader quickly streaked clear of a now vulnerable Norris by two seconds.
“I’ve got no rear,” reported the reigning world champion, who couldn’t keep his eyes off the Ferrari and Mercedes in his mirrors and that pressure from behind never died.
It resulted in Leclerc finally making his overtake down the inside of Norris at Turn 1 on lap 18 and while the Ferrari quickly pulled ahead, the McLaren still had to defend from Antonelli.
But once again at Zandvoort, staying within a second of the car in front is one thing, yet overtaking is another and all Norris really needed to do was keep it within the white lines.
That he did so the 26-year-old managed to hold on to third behind winner Russell, who crossed the line 1.4 seconds ahead of Leclerc, the Ferrari driver taking his third sprint podium of 2026.
Antonelli took fourth, 0.4s off Norris, with an extra 4.6s to fifth-placed Piastri who had Red Bull’s Max Verstappen just 0.3s behind in sixth in front of his home crowd.
Lewis Hamilton was never in contention aboard the sister Ferrari as he took seventh, with Alpine’s Pierre Gasly completing the points positions in eighth.
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯车手安东内利在SQ1倒数第二个弯道失误损失下压力，最终从第五位发车，以第四名完赛。
勒克莱尔使用软胎起步，在第18圈1号弯内线超越诺里斯升至第二。
维斯塔潘主场作战获得第六，汉密尔顿第七，加斯利第八拿下最后一分。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes driver Antonelli lost downforce after an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1, started fifth and finished fourth.
Leclerc, who started on soft tyres, overtook Norris on the inside at Turn 1 on lap 18 to take second.
Verstappen finished sixth in front of his home crowd, Hamilton was seventh and Gasly took the final point in eighth.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.

赫塔在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛。

Herta competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016.
